title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 37: Local community (Set 1)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Local community (Set 1) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Local community (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Read the conversation and then choose the correct answer to fill in each blank. Anna: Hi, Tom! I went to the local market in the nearby village this morning. The 13.1 composers artisans there makes beautiful pottery. Tom: That sounds amazing! What do they make the pottery 13.2 by from ? Anna: They use clay from the nearby river to make all sorts of things. I’m really impressed by their skill. Tom: Wow! I want something special to buy for my parents. Maybe I should check it out. Anna: You should! I think you’ll find something perfect. The people in the village are 13.3 asking looking for young clever people. They want to 13.4 put hand down their techniques to the younger generation to preserve the traditional handicraft.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài Local community (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Read the following leaflet and choose the option that best fits each blank. Join the Local Handicraft Fair This Weekend! Are you looking for unique handmade items? Come to our local handicraft fair this weekend! Why Attend? Discover beautiful traditional handicrafts made from natural materials. Support artisans and learn about the rich history of local crafts. Activities Included: Take part in a workshop to learn how to make 15.1 feather silk metal paper fans from wood. Meet and talk to 15.2 competitive amateur rude skilled  artisans who have a lot of experience in their craft. Shop for unique, one-of-a-kind gifts. See an exhibition of pictures made from pottery of talented 15.3 classmates artists bartenders assistants . 🛒 As a(n) 15.4 professor victim owner consumer , you’ll have the chance to find unique products or even make your own products. So don’t miss out on this opportunity to admire beautiful handicrafts and local culture!

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài Local community (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Write suitable words to complete the conversation. Linda: Hey, Tom! I went to the local fair near the 12.1 yesterday. It was so much fun! Tom: That sounds great! What did you see there? Linda: They had beautiful 12.2 in different colors everywhere. They made the fair feel festive. Tom: Wow, that must have looked amazing! Did you buy anything? Linda: Yes, I bought a 12.3 . It was really hot that day! Tom: Good choice! Did they have any handicrafts there? Linda: Many. I saw a stall with 12.4 . They looked so comfortable and unique. Tom: That sounds interesting! I've never seen such things. I'll visit the fair next time. Linda: You should! It’s nice to see our community organizing such fun events.
